revision: S8 single board P1: one carrier, every part on F, trial placement, UNROUTED
status: Trial placement for review. No tracks, vias or zones. Not a release.
panel_source: modules/blank/docs/geometry.json blank-4hp: 20.0 x 128.5, rail hole X12.58, Y3/Y125.5, dia 3.2

rail_profile_YZ_mm.note: case/tools/build_case.py: rail 10.0 wide centred on the hole line, 13.5 deep behind the panel rear; clear gap >= 112.5

native_carrier_map: native x = Y + 35.75; native y = 104.275 - Z (old usb-power carrier map)

depth_target.basis: user 2026-11-01: "you can go up to 50mm depth for panel". Read strictly: the board and every part end at Z50 from the panel FRONT (= 48.4 behind its rear face), which satisfies both readings
depth_target.case_note: In the 60 mm case (bus plate top 58.4 behind the panel rear, bus header tops 15.7 above it) the bus headers end 42.7 behind the panel rear: a 48.4 deep board must sit beside a bus header, not over it. The case/cable route is a user check, not modelled here.

USB.mount: SMD signal pads + 4 THT shell lugs (mixed)
USB.model_status: No verified 3D model: dimensioned envelope only (copied from usb-power).

LED.type: THT 3 mm round LED, leads formed 90 degrees (old D10 footprint/style, hand-soldered)
LED.note: S8: one panel LED (D8 MAIN). No LED MPN selected (manual part, user stock 3 mm red). Form leads in a jig with the panel.

switch.mount: SMT side-actuated (NOT through-hole); hand-solder toe pads; 2 NPTH pegs
switch.model_status: No verified 3D model: dimensioned envelope only (copied from usb-power).

header.orientation: long axis along Y; pins 1/2 (-12V) at the high-Y end (module bottom), odd row at the higher Z; ribbon must leave toward +Z (case floor/bus)
header.reference_body: Wurth 61201621621 WR-BHD box header: L 27.98, W 8.85, H 9.1 (+/-0.15) above PCB
header.note: J2/J3 = Wurth 61201621621 (selected in the S8 table), hand-soldered THT.

mating_plug.status: PROPOSAL ENVELOPE - cable/plug is not specified in the BOM; fit is NOT proven
mating_plug.reference: 3M D891 / 89116 16-way IDC socket drawing 78-5100-2243-3: body 24.9 x 6.1; assembled height 14.5 without, 16.3 with standard strain relief (text-extracted drawing values; dimension assignment to be confirmed)
mating_plug.requirement: 16-pin keyed IDC socket + 1.27 mm ribbon, mated height <= 14.8 mm above carrier F.Cu (X <= 18.9), ribbon leaving toward +Z. A clip-type strain relief reaching 16.3 mm (X 20.4) overhangs the 4HP panel edge X20.0 and is not allowed unless measured lower.

brackets.shape: Plain L, no nut traps or inserts
brackets.side_bolt: M3 x 8 flat countersunk, 90 degrees; length includes head
brackets.washers: No washers in specified length stacks. Plain hex nuts, not nyloc.
brackets.access: OUT OF RACK. Loose nuts and holding tool enter from +X. Front driver -Z; flush side driver -X. Main PCB can stay soldered and fitted.
brackets.material: ABS prototype candidate; print L profile flat, measure shrinkage and trial fit
brackets.note: Foot3.0mm, PCB web2.4mm +0.0/-0.1 (measured); countersink only in PRINTED bracket, never PCB. Front nut nominal clearance to upright is0.725mm. No print/strength qualification.

smd_parking.note: Unplaced SMD parked OFF-BOARD to the +native-x side (beyond Y114.5): NOT placed

single_side: every part on F (user 2026-11-01: "Use single side for now"); B face: copper only

inductor_body.basis: SLO1040 class 10 x 10 x 4.0 mm (footprint L_SLO1040H6R8MTT has no 3D model; renders use a 10 x 10 x 4 proxy)

depth_mm.ribbon: leaves the plug toward +Z and continues past Z50 to the bus header (not module depth)

report.m3_parts: F-side nut + 8 mm driver circles (Y22/Y106.5, Z15, r4.0) are checked against every placed courtyard and 3D body by tools/check_s8_board.py

risks.measure: margin to the 4HP panel edge X20 (negative = beyond the panel)
risks.detail: A clip-type strain relief at the drawing worst case (16.3 mm mated height) reaches X20.4: 0.4 mm past the 4HP edge, into the neighbouring module. Use a socket without the tall strain relief (or measure a lower one) on J2/J3.

risks.measure: mated IDC plug/ribbon envelope margin to the 4HP panel edge X20
risks.detail: The PROPOSAL mated envelope (14.8 mm max above F.Cu) leaves only 1.1 mm. The cable/plug is not in the BOM and the drawing dimensions were text-extracted; freeze the socket/ribbon part and check the tolerance stack with the neighbouring module in the case.

risks.measure: board rear edge below the bus header tops in the 60 mm case
risks.detail: The 48.4 mm deep board cannot sit directly over a busboard header in the 60 mm case.
U23 (2.1 x 2.1 x 1.0 max-body proxy), J1, SW1 and L1-L3 are proxies, not manufacturer models; the 3D screen is nominal, not an assembly approval.
